# co2ntent

An R package for calculating carbon dioxide and oxygen content of blood.

The co2ntent package provides several canonical formulae from the
literature, for the calculation of carbon dioxide and oxygen content of
the blood.

Some data sets presented in the referenced literature are also included.

Several helper methods for units conversion are also provided.

## Installing the development version

You can use the [devtools](https://github.com/hadley/devtools/wiki)
package by [Hadley Wickham](http://had.co.nz/) to automate the process
(make sure you follow [the full instructions to get
started](http://www.rstudio.com/projects/devtools/)):

``` r

if (! requireNamespace("devtools")) install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("bakenzua/co2ntent")
```

## Example

This is an example demonstrating how `con2tent` can be used with
tidyverse functions on the inbuilt dataset.

``` r

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(co2ntent)

# Table 3 data from Douglas et al 1988
names(co2ntent::douglas_table_3)
# [1] "subject"                  "sample_type"              "ph"
# [4] "haemoglobin_g_dl"         "so2_fraction"             "blood_co2_content_ml_dl"
# [7] "pco2_torr"                "plasma_co2_content_ml_dl"

co2ntent::douglas_table_3 |>
  mutate(
    # calculate douglas blood content
    douglas_calculated_content_blood_ml_dl = co2_content(
      pco2 = pco2_torr,
      ph = ph,
      haemoglobin_g_dl = haemoglobin_g_dl,
      so2_fraction = so2_fraction,
      phase = "blood",
      method = "douglas",
      content_units = "ml/dL",
      pressure_units = "mmHg"
    ),
    siggaard_calculated_content_blood_ml_dl = co2_content(
      # calculate hco3
      hco3_mmols_l = purrr::map2_dbl(
        pco2_torr,
        ph,
        actual_bicarbonate_content_mmol_l,
        pressure_units = "mmHg"
      ),
      pco2 = pco2_torr,
      haemoglobin_g_dl = haemoglobin_g_dl,
      so2_fraction = so2_fraction,
      ph = ph,
      phase = "blood",
      method = "siggaard_andersen",
      content_units = "ml/dL",
      pressure_units = "mmHg"
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    blood_co2_content_ml_dl,
    douglas_calculated_content_blood_ml_dl,
    siggaard_calculated_content_blood_ml_dl
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    c(
      douglas_calculated_content_blood_ml_dl,
      siggaard_calculated_content_blood_ml_dl
    ),
    names_to = "calculated_method",
    values_to = "calculated_content"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    calculated_method = if_else(
      calculated_method == "douglas_calculated_content_blood_ml_dl",
      "Douglas",
      "Siggard-Andersen"
    )
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(
    blood_co2_content_ml_dl,
    calculated_content,
    colour = calculated_method
  )) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = 'lm') +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "Comparison of methods of CO2 content calculation vs Actual Content",
    subtitle = "Original data from Loeppky, Luft, and Fletcher (1983)",
    x = "Actual CO2 content ml/dl",
    y = "Calculated CO2 content ml/dl",
    colour = "Calculation Method"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

![](reference/figures/co2ntent_readme.png)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`blood_oxygen_content_mls_dl()`](https://bakenzua.github.io/co2ntent/reference/blood_oxygen_content_mls_dl.md)
  : Calculate the O2 content of blood
- [`co2_content()`](https://bakenzua.github.io/co2ntent/reference/co2_content.md)
  : High-level interface for CO2 content calculations
- [`douglas_blood_co2_content_ml_dl()`](https://bakenzua.github.io/co2ntent/reference/douglas_blood_co2_content_ml_dl.md)
  : Calculate CO2 content of whole blood via Douglas method
- [`douglas_plasma_co2_content_ml_dl()`](https://bakenzua.github.io/co2ntent/reference/douglas_plasma_co2_content_ml_dl.md)
  : Calculate CO2 content of plasma via Douglas method
- [`douglas_table_3`](https://bakenzua.github.io/co2ntent/reference/douglas_table_3.md)
  : Table 3 - 38 arterial and venous blood gas measurements.
- [`douglas_table_4`](https://bakenzua.github.io/co2ntent/reference/douglas_table_4.md)
  : Table 4 - 46 arterial blood gas measurements.
- [`kelman_po2_to_so2()`](https://bakenzua.github.io/co2ntent/reference/kelman_po2_to_so2.md)
  : Calculate SO2 from pO2 of blood.
- [`kpa_to_mmhg()`](https://bakenzua.github.io/co2ntent/reference/kpa_to_mmhg.md)
  : Convert kPa to mmHg
- [`loeppky_blood_co2_content_ml_dl()`](https://bakenzua.github.io/co2ntent/reference/loeppky_blood_co2_content_ml_dl.md)
  : Calculate CO2 content of blood via Loeppky method
- [`mmhg_to_kpa()`](https://bakenzua.github.io/co2ntent/reference/mmhg_to_kpa.md)
  : Convert mmHg to kPa
- [`mmols_l_to_mls_dl()`](https://bakenzua.github.io/co2ntent/reference/mmols_l_to_mls_dl.md)
  [`mls_dl_to_mmols_l()`](https://bakenzua.github.io/co2ntent/reference/mmols_l_to_mls_dl.md)
  : Convert mmol/L ↔ mL/dL for CO2, O2 or ideal gas
- [`o2_content()`](https://bakenzua.github.io/co2ntent/reference/o2_content.md)
  : High-level interface for O2 content of blood
- [`po2_to_so2()`](https://bakenzua.github.io/co2ntent/reference/po2_to_so2.md)
  : High-level interface for pO2 to SO2
- [`siggaard_andersen_blood_co2_content_mmol_l()`](https://bakenzua.github.io/co2ntent/reference/siggaard_andersen_blood_co2_content_mmol_l.md)
  : Calculate whole blood CO2 content as per Siggaard-Andersen method.
- [`siggaard_andersen_plasma_co2_content_mmol_l()`](https://bakenzua.github.io/co2ntent/reference/siggaard_andersen_plasma_co2_content_mmol_l.md)
  : Calculate plasma CO2 content as per Siggaard-Andersen method.
